issues: Console error 'Invalid style property of padding. Value is 0 8px' — shorthand padding not supported by RN Web StyleSheet; split into paddingVertical/paddingHorizontal.

action_items: Optional cleanup: fix shorthand 'padding: 0 8px' RN Web console error by splitting into paddingHorizontal/paddingVertical (not blocking).
critical_code_review_comments: labour_statistics.py:159 avg_str formula '(len(act) + len(act) + exits - joins) / 2 or 1' can yield a negative denominator if joins > exits + 2*strength; guard with max(1, ...).
annual_returns.py:_fy_months uses '(i >= 9)' to bump the year for Jan-Mar; correct but a comment would help future maintainers.

factory_compliance.py:_computed muster-roll: 'out_t = times[0], times[-1] if len(times) > 1 else ""' assigns tuple to out_t due to Python precedence — should wrap 'times[-1] if ... else ""' branches so in_t stays a str. Tests pass because rows still exist; recommend fix.
